baselines: PCA reconstruction on each safe condition with q-only score

behavior.group: analysis_unit + flow_id; analysis_unit is certified capture when complete, otherwise fixed parent-order block
behavior.state_reset: at every analysis unit and on within-flow packet_index non-increase or timestamp backstep

claim_boundary: no session-independence claim from capture files alone
materialized sample evaluation is not full-stream deployment evaluation

intervention.direct_neutralization: set only raw frame.time_epoch to fit-normal median; q/r/b remain fixed
intervention.track1: fixed weights + fixed scaler + fixed original calibration threshold
intervention.track2: fixed weights + fixed scaler + threshold recalibrated on shifted normal-calibration only
intervention.translation_controls: global or analysis-group-hash-signed raw epoch offsets; preserve q/r/b

legacy_evidence_policy.development_probes_08_09: exploratory; excluded from new final evidence
legacy_evidence_policy.v3_controlled_intervention: historical final experimental evidence; not overwritten

non_executable_gates.T02_literature_novelty: requires primary-source literature review outside this script
non_executable_gates.T14_manuscript_rewrite: requires explicit user confirmation after evidence review

representation.primary_score: mean squared reconstruction error over common q components only
representation.q: legacy FINAL_33 excluding inter_arrival_time; no frame.time_epoch
representation.r: legacy inter_arrival_time (global-table predecessor delta per audits; bridge only)
representation.secondary_score: mean squared reconstruction error over all condition input/output components
representation.t: frame.time_epoch scaled in float64 before float32 model input

split.fallback: fixed parent-order blocks classified from parent labels; only pure-normal blocks may enter fit/early-stop/calibration; attack/mixed blocks are test; explicitly not capture- or session-disjoint
split.old_sample_exposure: all materialized sample rows were previously available in historical experiments; new test means held out from this new fit/tuning/calibration only
split.preferred: capture-file-disjoint pure-normal development partitions plus attack/mixed captures held out

statistics.fpr: measured held-out FPR; no assumption that P99 guarantees 1%
statistics.model_seed_handling: average analysis-unit FNR across model seeds before acquisition-group inference
statistics.multiplicity: Holm separately within each planned contrast family across dataset-model comparisons
statistics.primary_group: analysis unit: certified raw capture only when complete mapping exists; otherwise fixed parent-order block
statistics.secondary_test: Wilcoxon signed-rank only when >=5 acquisition groups
